snippet.title: How Jay Jay OKOCHA GOT TRICKED Into the Premier League 🤣
snippet.description:
Jay-Jay Okocha played at Old Trafford. He'd seen the stadium, the lights, the crowd... and he assumed that was English football. So when the move came, he said yes to Bolton without doing his research. That decision came back to bite him later, in the least glamorous training ground he ever trained in.

The club knew exactly what they were doing. They picked him up at Manchester Airport and drove him straight to the Reebok Stadium to sell the dream. Talks happened at the hotel. Nobody offered him a tour of the training ground. That only came after he'd signed, and what he walked into was a "cabin" turned changing room, with a shower that fit three men at a time. No rotation, no system. You queued. First come, first served.

It's one of those stories that pulls the curtain back on what "moving to the Premier League" in the old days actually looked like away from the 
cameras.
